title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
source: AUD mC> Rx2> DAT> CDR; this new version has been pitch adjusted with the following ratios: acoustic set with a 'slight' sliding time scale/pitch shift of +0.123%; 2) electric set with a sliding time scale/pitch shift of +9.678%; (electric [lower volume level] set has also been amplified by +3.9%)

ai_review.summary: Excellent multi‑channel matrix capture of a rare acoustic/electric show featuring the first recordings of "Ripple" and "Broke Down Palace", with rich audience ambience.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers award five stars, praising this version as a “gift from the gods.” The recording delivers crystal‑clear acoustic tracks and an enhanced 7‑channel electric mix while preserving the priceless crowd atmosphere. Highlights include the debut performances of Ripple and Broke Down Palace, and Jerry Garcia’s multi‑instrumental prowess throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic 5‑star reviews focusing on both stellar performance and superb recording quality; no negative comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note pure direct settings for the acoustic set and a 7‑channel enhanced mix for the electric portion, with vivid audience ambience that adds depth without muddying the sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The acoustic/electric format is praised as a complete gift; reviewers love the set list and how the band weaves divergent material together.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for playing three bands on three instruments, showcasing his versatility.
